title: Sadhana Pada
summary: The second chapter of Patanjali's Yoga Sutras outlines the practical steps of Kriya Yoga and the first five limbs of Ashtanga Yoga.

verses.translation: Austerity, self-study, and devotion to the Lord constitute Kriya Yoga.
verses.meaning: tapah - austerity; svadhyaya - self-study; ishvara-pranidhanani - devotion/surrender to Ishvara; kriya-yogah - yoga of action/practice

verses.translation: By the practice of the limbs of Yoga, the impurities are destroyed, and the light of wisdom shines forth leading to discriminative discernment.
verses.meaning: yoga-anga - limbs of yoga; anusthanad - by practice; ashuddhi-kshaye - destruction of impurities...

verses.translation: Yama, Niyama, Asana, Pranayama, Pratyahara, Dharana, Dhyana, and Samadhi are the eight limbs of Yoga.
verses.meaning: yama - restraints; niyama - observances; asana - posture; pranayama - breath control; pratyahara - withdrawal of senses; dharana - concentration; dhyana - meditation; samadhi - absorption
